blocks.raw: # Configuring Request Workflow for Badge Issuance
blocks.text: Configuring Request Workflow for Badge Issuance

blocks.raw: This request is mapped to a standard workflow and allows you to submit requests to issue badges for customers.
blocks.text: This request is mapped to a standard workflow and allows you to submit requests to issue badges for customers.

blocks.raw: As part of the standard workflow, the Capillary platform provides a two-step approval process involving a Maker and Checker-based workflow.
blocks.text: As part of the standard workflow, the Capillary platform provides a two-step approval process involving a Maker and Checker-based workflow.

blocks.raw:
1. Users with “CanMakeRequest” access can submit a request to issue a badge to a customer.
2. Users with “CanCheckRequest” access can approve or reject the request.
blocks.text: Users with “CanMakeRequest” access can submit a request to issue a badge to a customer.Users with “CanCheckRequest” access can approve or reject the request.

blocks.raw: Once a Checker approves a request, the system executes it, issuing a badge to a customer.
blocks.text: Once a Checker approves a request, the system executes it, issuing a badge to a customer.

blocks.raw: You can enable **Auto-approval** configuration to enable auto-approval of certain user requests.
blocks.text: You can enable Auto-approval configuration to enable auto-approval of certain user requests.

blocks.raw: To configure, from the Request Workflows list, navigate to **Earn\_badge** > **Edit request workflow mapping**, turn on the **Auto-approval flag** toggle and click **Save**
blocks.text: To configure, from the Request Workflows list, navigate to Earn_badge > Edit request workflow mapping, turn on the Auto-approval flag toggle and click Save
